stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $902 \times 119$ is divided by $19$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $902 \equiv 9$ and $119 \equiv 5 \pmod{19}$. So the product is $\equiv 9 \times 5 = 45 \equiv 7 \pmod{19}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
